prompts.title: Recent Form — Kinetic Type vs Grouped Count Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 montage about recent form, roughly 6–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 base, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents; keep the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT — kinetic typography: the Spanish heading 'FORMA RECIENTE' snaps in letter by letter in warm white; 'SABAH FK' slams in on the beat with a lime underline whip, then 'BORUSSIA DORTMUND' counters from the opposite edge in slate; rhythmic emphasis comes from scale pulses on each team name plus a subtle camera shake on the downbeat; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events; a luma-wipe transition carries the type off-screen upward. STATISTICAL VARIANT — grouped count bars on one shared zero baseline with a common scale so all six bars are directly comparable: cluster 'Sabah FK' with Spanish bar labels 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas' resolving {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, and cluster 'Borussia Dortmund' resolving {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}; axis unit 'partidos'; color bars by category (victories lime, draws warm white, defeats slate) so the eye reads one focal comparison; sample captions 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' under the home cluster and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos' under the away cluster make each sample size explicit, so unequal samples would be visible at a glance; add a small slate source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' just above the subtitle band. Entry: the baseline draws left to right, bars grow bottom-up with a tight stagger, value labels pop as each bar lands; emphasis: the two 'Victorias' bars pulse once in lime; camera: slow push-in, then hold. Exit: bars retract into the baseline and the panel wipes downward as the transition into the next block. Maintain one focal point, generous margins, professional hierarchy and legible Spanish labels at all times.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against — Pitch Illustration vs Paired Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 scene about goals, 6–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT — illustrative football pitch: a vertical pitch drawn as lime line-art; a warm white ball travels a curved dashed path from midfield toward the top goal with a gentle camera push following it, then a second path curls toward the bottom goal; kinetic Spanish words 'GOLES A FAVOR' and 'GOLES EN CONTRA' flash with each impact; team names 'SABAH FK' and 'BORUSSIA DORTMUND' tag their halves; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events; the ball exits frame right as the transition. STATISTICAL VARIANT — paired bars for both teams on one shared zero baseline and one common scale, unit 'goles': for 'Sabah FK', 'A favor' resolves {{home.gf}} and 'En contra' resolves {{home.ga}}; for 'Borussia Dortmund', 'A favor' resolves {{away.gf}} and 'En contra' resolves {{away.ga}}; 'A favor' bars in lime, 'En contra' bars in slate, so the football context reads instantly as attack versus defence; unambiguous Spanish legend and axis titles; sample captions 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos (Sabah FK)' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos (Borussia Dortmund)' sit beneath each pair, with a small slate source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' above the subtitle band. Entry: baseline draws first, each pair grows simultaneously bottom-up, value labels pop after landing; emphasis: one lime pulse on the 'A favor' pair, then a slate bracket underlines the 'En contra' contrast; camera: slow push-in and hold. Exit: bars sink into the baseline, the pitch line-art ghosts back for two frames, and a vertical wipe transition clears the frame. One focal point, clean hierarchy, legible Spanish labels throughout.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets — Shield Energy vs Count Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 scene about defensive solidity, 6–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 canvas, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT — defensive energy: a stylised shield drawn in lime strokes sits center frame; concentric arcs pulse outward like a goalkeeper's aura while warm white sparks deflect off its rim; the Spanish heading 'SOLIDEZ DEFENSIVA' sets above, and the emblem alternates between 'SABAH FK' in lime and 'BORUSSIA DORTMUND' in slate on a hard-cut beat; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events; a slight orbital camera drift keeps the frame alive; the shield collapses into a single horizontal line that becomes the exit transition. STATISTICAL VARIANT — clean sheet counts compared without any conversion into rates: two vertical count bars on a shared zero baseline and a common scale, unit 'partidos', Spanish label 'Arcos en cero'; the 'Sabah FK' bar resolves {{home.clean}} and the 'Borussia Dortmund' bar resolves {{away.clean}}; show raw counts only — no rates, no derived fractions, no secondary axis; sample captions 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos (Sabah FK)' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos (Borussia Dortmund)' state the sample size beside each bar, with a small slate source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' above the subtitle band. Entry: the collapsed shield line re-extends as the baseline, bars grow bottom-up, count labels pop; emphasis: whichever bar stands taller pulses once in lime while the other holds slate, preserving a single focal point; camera: slow push-in, then settle. Exit: bars retract into the baseline, the shield emblem flashes for one beat, and a downward wipe transition hands over to the next block. Legible Spanish labels and professional hierarchy throughout.

prompts.title: Synthesis — Attack Meets Defence
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 synthesis scene, 6–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 base, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. EDITORIAL VARIANT — team reveals with narrative emphasis: a diagonal split reveals 'SABAH FK' on the upper half in lime with forward arrow motifs surging upward, then 'BORUSSIA DORTMUND' on the lower half in slate with a steady wall motif; the Spanish headline 'ATAQUE CONTRA DEFENSA' stamps across the seam in warm white; a slow zoom and a lime slash drawing the diagonal carry the narrative emphasis; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events, no predictive wording; the diagonal closes like a shutter as the exit transition. STATISTICAL VARIANT — one grounded tension told through three compatible mini-groups, each on its own shared zero baseline with a common scale inside the group: 'Goles a favor' (unit 'goles') with 'Sabah FK' resolving {{home.gf}} and 'Borussia Dortmund' resolving {{away.gf}}; 'Goles en contra' (unit 'goles') with 'Sabah FK' resolving {{home.ga}} and 'Borussia Dortmund' resolving {{away.ga}}; 'Arcos en cero' (unit 'partidos') with 'Sabah FK' resolving {{home.clean}} and 'Borussia Dortmund' resolving {{away.clean}}; lime for Sabah FK bars, slate for Borussia Dortmund bars, one shared legend; sample caption 'Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos' plus a small slate source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' above the subtitle band; a Spanish disclaimer 'Datos recientes · No es un pronóstico' anchors the panel. Entry: groups fade up in sequence, bars grow bottom-up, labels pop; emphasis: the 'Goles en contra' pair pulses once to underline the tension; camera: slow push-in and hold. Exit: bars retract, groups stack and slide off as the transition. One focal point, legible Spanish labels, professional hierarchy throughout.
